messages:
Alex: Quick sync on autofallback operator path. Need: short "why" card + inspect + low-friction retry that shows quota impact.

Maria: Make reason human-friendly, show rule name, suggested next steps, and RBAC for overrides.

Sam: Include small telemetry snapshot (p50/p95, error class, success ratio) + redacted token sample and trace link.

OpsBot: (deploy) policy v2.3 canary -> 10% routes.

Alex: UI idea: collapsed card with title line (reason + rule), telemetry icons, actions (retry/open/pin). Expand -> side panel with trace + sampling info.

Jon: Retry modal should show estimated quota burn and whether it will hit same route or fallback variant. Async toast after submit.

Maria: Add trace labels: fallback.trigger, fallback.rule, fallback.confidence, sample_rate. Also include privacy blurb when payloads are redacted.

Sam: Sampling: route-hash 1% default, auto-upweight when fallback rate >0.5% in 10m, operator inspect flips to 100% for that request for 5m. CLI QA flag to force full capture.

Todd: API: create /operator/ack and /operator/inspect endpoints (separate from rollout API) to simplify audit trails.

Maria: Overrides require ops:override and must produce immutable audit entry (operator id, ts, request id, action).

Jon: Accessibility: labeled icons and keyboard nav for quick triage.

Alex: Action items: Todd -> OpenAPI for operator endpoints; Maria -> trace schema + blurb; Sam -> sampling PoC; Jon -> quick UI mock; Alex -> RFC PR with wireframes. Sync Tues 9:30.

Maria: Blurb suggestion: "Payload redacted by default to protect user privacy. Operators can request replay for approved audits; replay creates an access log entry."

Sam: I'll add inspect hook to sampling PoC.
thread_snapshot: operator inbox UX for autofallback, telemetry labels, sampling rules, dedicated operator endpoints, RBAC and privacy blurb
